title: Inside Beauty Banking: Top Women Dealmakers Discuss Career Paths, Trends, and the Current Dealscape
summary: Four powerhouse women in beauty investment banking come together for a roundtable discussion, sharing insights on breaking barriers in a male-dominated field and the ever-evolving M&A landscape.
